text:
The change spec has been written and validated section by section under `.sdlc/runs/20261106-103201-bugfix-dark-eyedropper/change.sections/`:

- **`header.json`**: Defines repo conventions, architectural decisions for `applyDarkModeFilterToRgb` / `invertDarkModeFilter` and `EyeDropper.tsx` dark-theme conversion, single-file `lint` (`yarn eslint --max-warnings=0 {path}`) and `test` (`yarn test:app --watch=false {path}`) checks, and the fixed project check `yarn test:typecheck && yarn test:code && yarn test:app --watch=false`.
- **`units-001.json`**:
  - **`U01` (`packages/common/src/colors.test.ts`, `tests`, red check)**: Adds unit tests for `invertDarkModeFilter` covering the sampled RGB grid redraw round-trip (`< 1s`), exact hex recovery for `#1e1e1e`, `#000000`, and `#ffffff`, `#rrggbbaa` alpha preservation, valid non-throwing hex output for unreachable pixels, and `Map.prototype.set` spy verification that `DARK_MODE_COLORS_CACHE` is untouched (`FR-1..FR-4`, `NFR-1`, `NFR-2`, `NFR-4`, `AC-4..AC-8`).
  - **`U02` (`packages/excalidraw/tests/eyeDropper.test.tsx`, `tests`, red check)**: Adds reproducing jsdom tests for dark-theme eyedropper colour picking on a selected shape and `ColorInput`, dark-theme bucket-fill temporary eyedropper (`openTemporaryEyeDropper`), and unchanged light-theme colour picking (`FR-5..FR-7`, `AC-1..AC-3`, `AC-7`).
  - **`U03` (`packages/common/src/colors.ts`, `codegen`)**: Extracts the uncached `applyDarkModeFilterToRgb` helper and implements and exports `invertDarkModeFilter(color: string): string` (`FR-1..FR-4`, `NFR-2..NFR-4`, `AC-4..AC-8`).
  - **`U04` (`packages/excalidraw/components/EyeDropper.tsx`, `codegen`)**: Converts sampled pixels through `invertDarkModeFilter` in `getCurrentColor` when `appState.theme === THEME.DARK` while keeping `colorPreviewDiv.style.background` set to the raw on-screen pixel hex (`FR-5..FR-7`, `NFR-3`, `AC-1..AC-3`, `AC-7`).
  - **`U05` (`packages/excalidraw/CHANGELOG.md`, `codegen`)**: Adds an unreleased fix entry for the dark-theme eyedropper colour fix (`FR-8`).
